children: GameStop entered into amendments to its previously announced exchange agreements with existing holders of its 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 and 2032. The changes end the remaining pricing reference period, with the elapsed portion settled in stock and the remainder settled in cash based on the prior trading day. In total, noteholders will receive about 55.5 million shares (approximately 73% of consideration) and $358.4 million in cash (approximately 27%). Closing is expected on or about September 3, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
